title: 6 Shaman

sources.label: STRONGEST Endgame 6 Shaman Builds In Dota 2 Auto Chess

body:
# 6 Shaman

6 Shaman is a high-variance, economy-first comp built around the Shaman class perk: after any Shaman casts a spell or activates an item, it transforms into a random chess piece two levels higher. Stack six different Shamans and their carried items transform too, so a fight opens with your whole back line morphing into inflated, random high-cost units. The catch is that you never fully control what you become, so the comp is carried by two things you *can* control: a fat Orc HP pool that keeps your line alive through the 1.5s transform windows, and a ruthless economy that gets you to the legendaries first.

The power spike is the mid-to-late game once you hit six Orcs alongside three-plus Shamans. Orc grants a massive HP bonus that scales as your courier health drops, so this deck is one of the rare builds that is *stronger* while you sit low on life. Played well you stabilise several rounds earlier than the lobby; played greedily and unlucky, you bleed out before your legendaries show up.

## Core Units

The two must-find legendaries are **Disruptor** and **Arc Warden** — both Shamans, and Disruptor doubles as an Orc. Everything else is support for the transform loop and the Orc count.

| Unit | Cost | Synergies | Role |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Disruptor | 5 | Orc, Shaman | Opening silence, then transforms; wants Minotaur Horn |
| Arc Warden | 5 | Kobold, Shaman | Duplicates itself and items; hides in a corner |
| Warlock | 5 | Orc, Warlock | Sixth Orc, extra front-line body |
| Chen | 4 | Orc, Priest | Orc count + summons |
| Razor | 3 | Elemental, Shaman | Sixth Shaman |
| Earthshaker | 3 | Shaman, Tauren | Shaman filler |
| Blood Seeker | 2 | Orc, Shaman | Cheap Orc + Shaman overlap |
| Juggernaut | 2 | Orc, Warrior | Front-line Orc |
| Shadow Shaman | 1 | Shaman, Troll | Easiest Shaman to three-star |
| Axe | 1 | Orc, Warrior | Cheap front-line Orc |

Running Disruptor + Blood Seeker (both Orc/Shaman) lets you reach 6 Shaman and 6 Orc with only ten distinct units. When you can't find both key legendaries, the video shows two backup routes: use the **Magic Box** relic to re-roll legendaries you don't own into the pool, or fish for **Earth Spirit** (a Shaman that isn't in the standard pool) using a Panda plus the Lucky Pendant.

## Items

Shamans only transform once they *act*, so prioritise items that fire instantly at the start of combat.

- **Tier 1:** Blink Dagger is the single most important item — it activates the instant the fight begins, triggering the transform with no delay. Stack as many as you can and reroll everything else into them.
- **Tier 2/3:** Arcane Boots (the "mana boots" the guide hunts for) and Mask of Madness are strong instant-activation options. Guardian Greaves keeps the front line alive through the transform window.
- **Tier 4:** Minotaur Horn on Disruptor is the standout — an instant silence that buys the whole board time to transform. Necronomicon on Arc Warden is excellent because it adds one to every summon count, and Arc Warden's clones inherit the effect.
- **Avoid:** items that only proc on cast timers (e.g. Bottle is not a true instant-cast) since they delay the transform you actually want.

## Relics

- **Magic Box** — the signature tech. Re-roll it onto owned legendaries to morph them toward Shamans, and it can even pull legendaries that aren't in the current game. Grab it around round 20, not the first round-10 pick (it's an economy drag early).
- **Malefic Rapture** — converts the health you lose (while intentionally losing streaking) into extra experience, rushing you to level 9.
- **Leafy Essence** — post round-25 lifesteal and damage reduction; take the lifesteal talent variant if you skip it.
- **Stolen Vault** — straight gold when nothing better is on offer.

## Leveling / Roll Plan

The whole plan is economy: hard lose-streak from around round 4, sell aggressively to hit every interest breakpoint (19 → 29 → 39 gold), and use Bounty Hunters on the board for extra kill gold. Bank to 40+, then push levels while holding gold. Aim to be **level 9 before round 20** — far ahead of the lobby thanks to the loss-experience relics — and only start seriously rolling for Shamans then. Take the **Ascendancy** talent at level 15 for a higher legendary hit rate. Push level 10 before committing to a roll-down, and go 11–12 in the ultra-late game for extra Disruptors (more silence) rather than forcing three-star Shamans, which waste gold and transform into nothing special.

## Positioning / Matchup Notes

Put Orc tanks (Axe, Juggernaut, Chen, Warlock) up front to absorb damage during the transform windows, and keep Shamans in the back. Arc Warden lives in a corner so it survives to summon. Because Orc's HP bonus grows as your life drops, sitting at low HP is a feature, not a bug.

The comp's hardest matchup is fast-casting mages (five-Dragon mage lines). The answer is a **Stealth Assassin (Riki)** cloud plus Disruptor silences to shut down the enemy's opening burst — mirror your Riki placement round to round so opponents can't pre-position around it. Against three-star single carries the Orc HP wall usually wins outright.
